description: Implementation of Protocol Buffers support in Go using reflection, including pointer manipulation and atomic operations.

classes.name: field
classes.description: Type representing a struct field identified by index sequence.

classes.name: pointer
classes.description: Struct encapsulating a reflect.Value for pointer operations.

methods.name: toField
methods.description: Converts a reflect.StructField to internal field representation.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the field identifier is valid.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a struct's field given a field index.

methods.name: isNil
methods.description: Checks if the reflect.Value is nil.

methods.name: grow
methods.description: Increases the length of a slice by one, returning the new element.

methods.name: toInt64
methods.description: Returns a pointer to int64 from reflect.Value.

methods.name: getInt32Ptr
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to int32, handling enums.

methods.name: setInt32Ptr
methods.description: Sets a pointer to int32, handling enum conversion.

methods.name: getInt32Slice
methods.description: Copies a slice of int32 from reflect.Value, handling enums.

methods.name: setInt32Slice
methods.description: Copies a slice of int32 into reflect.Value, handling enums.

methods.name: appendInt32Slice
methods.description: Appends an int32 value to a slice.

methods.name: toUint64
methods.description: Returns a pointer to uint64.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a pointer to string.

methods.name: getPointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying reflect.Value.

methods.name: setPointer
methods.description: Sets the reflect.Value to another pointer.

methods.name: getPointerSlice
methods.description: Copies a slice of pointers from reflect.Value.

methods.name: setPointerSlice
methods.description: Copies a slice of pointers into reflect.Value.

methods.name: getInterfacePointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the interface data.

methods.name: asPointerTo
methods.description: Returns reflect.Value as a pointer to a specific type.

methods.name: atomicLoadUnmarshalInfo
methods.description: Atomically loads unmarshal info.

methods.name: atomicStoreUnmarshalInfo
methods.description: Atomically stores unmarshal info.
